findings.evidence: Statement at lines 356-357: `(hG2 : P.IsG2) (b : P.Base) : HasCartanType P b .G2`; the form appears only at line 362 inside the proof.
findings.fix: Delete the paragraph, or move it into the proof as a comment at line 362 and say "the argument" rather than "the statement".
findings.issue: "The root-positive form used is Mathlib's canonical `RootPairing.posRootForm`, but any other would do: the statement compares two lengths..." — the statement is `HasCartanType P b .G2` and mentions no form or length; this documents a proof-internal choice (`set Bf := P.posRootForm ℤ`, line 362) as if it were part of the interface.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/WeylGroup.lean:163 `abbrev weylGroupToPerm := (Equiv.indexHom P).domRestrict P.weylGroup`; the only `SMul`/`MulAction` instances for `P.weylGroup` in this repo are on `openWeylChambers` (Weyl/Chamber.lean:194,205), none on `ι`.
findings.fix: Write `P.weylGroupToPerm w i = j`, matching the statement.
findings.issue: Docstring says "each index `j` is `w • i`", but there is no scalar action of `P.weylGroup` on `ι`; Mathlib's `weylGroupToPerm` is a `MonoidHom` to `Equiv.Perm ι` and `•` on the Weyl group is the action on `M` (`weylGroup_apply_root : g • P.root i = P.root (P.weylGroupToPerm g i)`).

summary: New file and declarations are documented, and the module docstrings and cross-references check out against Mathlib. Two docstring inaccuracies: a paragraph on `hasCartanType_G2_of_isG2` documents a proof-internal choice and misdescribes what the statement says, and the Weyl-orbit docstring uses `•` notation for an action that does not exist on root indices.
